answer: Allocate new-agent trial jobs from one fixed budget, proportional to tokens locked times elapsed seconds, not account count. The contract integrates each deposit only while locked and resets its clock on withdrawal; transferred tokens cannot carry old credit into another key. At dawn an onyx ledger totals every claim, like one vine divided among pots: splitting 100 tokens across 100 aliases earns the same trial share as keeping them together. Extra access requires more capital held longer, not more names.
